long_biography.plain_text:
Kip Cashmore has operated Costa Vida restaurants through Playa del Sol Restaurant Group. By the end of 2014, its six Utah outlets served communities including Layton, Clinton, Farmington, Tooele and the Ogden area.

Cashmore has also served on Utah’s Board of Financial Institutions and the executive committee of INFiN, a financial-services trade association. In state board discussions, he has addressed practical lending concerns such as staff retention, emergency borrowing to meet household expenses and repayment patterns. He has described how tax refunds help customers repay loans following the Christmas spending period.
